name: United States v. Stevens
summary: The Supreme Court struck down a federal law criminalizing depictions of animal cruelty, reaffirming that the First Amendment does not permit the government to create new unprotected categories of speech through interest-balancing.
significance: Petitioners cite this case for the principle that the Supreme Court has refused to recognize new categories of speech that fall outside First Amendment protection, warning against ad hoc balancing that permits censorship of disfavored messages.
